description: tools/test-projects/navigation, a Release build (BUILD_TYPE=Release WEB_PROJECT=navigation tools/build.sh web, gated with GATE=navigation; WEB_THREADS=1 for both steps gives the pthreads build): a reduced bench_nav_city and nav_2d_topdown baked at runtime. Single-threaded, the tiles are time-sliced on the main thread and no slice exceeds the web bake budget + 2 ms (R23, release budgets); both builds log the same navmesh hashes (byte-identical bakes, AC20); a grid path is found and an agent walks the city and arrives. No pixel check.
